name: FinTV
description: Connects Jellyfin to FinTV Server. Syncs library metadata, paths, and chapters, registers M3U/XMLTV Live TV, and runs commercial blackframe detection.
overview: Thin Jellyfin bridge for FinTV Server — catalog sync, Live TV registration, and blackframe chapters

versions.changelog:
- Test FinTV Server URL and API key from the plugin page
- Queue catalog sync and blackframe scan as scheduled tasks
- Upload catalog metadata in chunks so large libraries do not time out
- Auto-register Live TV M3U and XMLTV
- Keep blackframe commercial chapter detection in Jellyfin

- Split FinTV into FinTV Server plus a thin Jellyfin plugin
- Sync library metadata, file paths, and chapters to FinTV Server
- Auto-register Live TV M3U and XMLTV
- Keep blackframe commercial chapter detection in Jellyfin
